title: Dry-run GitHub Actions: triggers, concurrency and billed minutes
acceptanceCriteria: A pull request's `branches` filter is matched against the branch it targets, so a stacked PR doesn't run a `branches: [main]` workflow
Without `types`, only `opened`, `synchronize` and `reopened` start a `pull_request` workflow; `edited` (a retarget) does only when listed
`paths-ignore` skips a run only when every changed file is ignored; `paths` runs when at least one file matches
In a busy concurrency group a newer run replaces the waiting one, which is cancelled; the running one is untouched
`billedMinutes` rounds each job up to a whole minute: `[40, 40, 40, 40]` bills 4
